facts.fact: 她被路面绊到，John 落在她身侧接住她、把她挡离车道。
facts.anchor: John catches me around the shoulders before I can begin my downward adventure and then forcefully moves me further from the street, standing as a blockade between me and danger.
“I’ve been in them about eight months now,” I manage to say, swallowing around the embarrassment thickening my tongue.

facts.fact: John 住了五年——令她吃惊。
John 只花自己挣的钱，还有过去欠下的债要还。
facts.anchor: “I only want to use the money I earn. I have a lot of…debt from my past that I am still attempting to repay. And that apartment isn’t so bad.”

facts.fact: 她与他说了同样的话：只用自己挣的钱，就当赎罪。
facts.anchor: My belly flips. “I understand that, I could use my family’s money. But I decided I wanted to only spend what I earned myself, too. I feel like I have made so many mistakes in life, and in some ways it’s my penance.”

facts.fact: 她感到同类般的共鸣与无法否认的吸引，但决定不深究。
facts.anchor: I feel a kindred energy with John. An attraction I can’t deny. But I won’t explore it, I can’t.

facts.fact: 说到街上的猫变少，她说是她带去绝育的。
facts.anchor: “I took a bunch to get spayed. Trying to help where I can.”
His arm extends, his hand hovering centimeters away from my cheek, as if physically stopping himself from touching me. “Who are you, Cinnamon?”

facts.fact: 她被狗绳绊倒，两人一起摔倒。
facts.anchor: Somehow I manage to tangle in Beanie’s leash and take us both to the ground.
“I’m bad luck,” I whisper softly, answering his question the only way I know how.
“Come up to my apartment?” I force from my lips before I can chicken out.

facts.fact: John 提醒她不该请陌生人进屋。
facts.anchor: “You shouldn’t invite strangers into your home.”

facts.fact: 她宣称我们是邻居、三十分钟就能开饭。
facts.anchor: “We’re neighbors. Thirty minutes is all I need to have food ready!”

facts.fact: 她的门把手拧不动——她从不上锁。
facts.anchor: Once I make it to my door, the handle doesn’t twist in my hand.

facts.fact: 打开冰箱看到奶酪，她立刻决定菜单。
facts.anchor: but when my eyes land on the cheese in the drawer, I know exactly what I will cook.
